verdict.rationale: Jira exposes REST APIs, and an official MCP server is documented, so issuing agent credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents scoped or least-privilege API tokens. 'Rich APIs', SAML/SSO and the MCP server listing are adjacent features and do not show that credentials can be limited in scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
